caveats: No commit in the current environment boots green under the WEDGE harness (--no-rcb-time): the commit bisect is invalid (all wedge; bare QEMU boots). The good->bad axis is the CONFIG, not the commit.

Wedge (full-Linux controller) and green (bare busybox) are DIFFERENT guests; cross-harness ratios are indicative of magnitude, not a single-variable measurement. The controlled busybox pair is the single-variable measurement.

Ad-hoc rcb-controller boots (metrics_boot.sh config=rcb) failed at QEMU-startup (harness-config mismatch vs hermit-220's landed demo config), NOT a scheduler wedge; excluded from scheduler conclusions.

DECISIVE: the full 3-knob wedge stack applied to a BARE BUSYBOX guest (busybox_pair.sh config=wedgekit) does NOT permanently wedge -- it boots to power-down, crawling (~493k turns, ~1450s vtime, ~85k timeslices, 387k syscalls; ~12x a green boot).
